name: Build and run apps in the cloud (Codex)
description: Create and run real web apps in the SiraGPT cloud runner with a live preview link — no downloads, no local app. ONLY call after the user explicitly confirmed they want an app built (never by inference). Actions: ensure_project, plan, build, status, preview, exec, read, cancel. Long builds return pending with a runId; re-check with status.

action.description: What to do. Use ensure_project first (or pass projectId), plan before build, preview after a done build.

projectId.description: Codex project id. Omit to resolve it from chatId.

chatId.description: Current /agentes chat id. Used to find or bind the project.

goal.description: What to plan or build (plan/build actions).

cmd.description: Allowlisted command argv, e.g. ["bun","--version"] (exec action). Runner enforces its own binary allowlist.

timeoutMs.description: Optional budget for exec/wait, clamped server-side.
